reviews.text: The vet there knows her animals. She treated my German shepherd with expertise. I loved the staff, reception to assistant to the actual vet. She did an aspiration on her mammory gland, ruled out cancer, and gave me her treatment. Everything was about 45 minutes from check-in to walking out.
Great visit.
Easy to book a quick appointment for my sick elderly cat. Dr. Flick is a joy! Very compassionate. Reasonable prices. And they have some weekend hours! Highly recommend.
Excellent. Staff always friendly and proficient.  Dr. Flick is a pleasure!!
Dr McCready is the best ever!!  Great bedside manner and explains everything thoroughly. Very caring!!

My great Dane and me went to see Dr. Pollard for a well check. ATHENA was such a good girl she behaved and everybody said she was the best they’ve seen there for great Danes of course mom was really really pleased to see that some of her training has paid off. Camelback always does a fabulous job with the animals. They’re the only that’s we’ve been to ever since I’ve had my dog and we would continue to go back there forever and I hope she lives forever.
Always a pleasant experience, they treat my boy Hank very well and explain everything to us thoroughly.
We take all of our furry kids there.
Great service, great staff. So glad to take my pets with them!
Camelwest is fantastic
Absolutely love Dr McCready. She really cares about her patients, takes time and listens to any and all my concerns. Great personality

Amazing animal hospital, have been going here for over 5 years. They’ve always given us the best care, and service for reasonable prices. We’ve taken our animals to other hospitals throughout the valley before and were always disappointed. Camelwest never disappoints, and takes great care of our fur babies

Greedy money hungry people would not help me with a abandoned animal that I found outside barely breathing and needed care. When they realized I couldn't afford what they were going to charge they stopped talking to me and refused to give care to the animal. You would think they could have at least try to help save it's life. I guess if there isn't profit to be made they won't help a dying animal, shame on you .
Staff was amazing in caring for our Snookie! She  had an allergic reaction that needed er care.  They cared for her in the most compassionate manner. Snookie is doing great!  THANK YOU!
Entire staff was fantastic!  My dogs are lucky to have this clinic looking after them for sure
We've been taking our pets to Camelwest Animal Hospital for many years and experienced great service every time. The staff handles pets with love, care, and expertise. Our little Lulu was happy!

Dr. Pollard was great. My puppy loved her and she did a good job at reassuring us that her health was important to them. The staff is also really kind and accommodating.

I just met with their new vet and she’s also extremely nice and friendly. My pup loved her.
Great services. Friendly crew
As usual, we are always greeted with friends faces. Everyone is professional, courteous, and provides exceptional care.
Wonderful treatment of my sick cat.  Appreciated the ease of scheduling.
Wonderful vet! Saved my boy's life. 🐕
Clean facility. Competent and kind staff. Dr. McCready, as always, was so caring and thorough even though it was late in the day. I highly recommend.

Amazing staff! Everyone is super friendly and kind. The doctor took the time to throughly explain the results of the different exams on my pet. They also followed up with me and made sure to answer any and all of my questions. These people really care about what they do and it shows! I appreciate them and would recommend them to everyone!
Took my dog in for an exam and his rabies shot, they were very friendly and explained everything. They were super patient and calm when my dog was scared of getting the shots.

Had a good first visit. I made an appointment same and the staff were great, from the initial call to the doggie bag full of care for my puppy. The doctor and  assistant were very helpful, thorough, and patient with us. Very clean and welcoming environment. Don’t hesitate to give them a call and make your pet feel better! 🐶
Thank you for trimming Toby’s nails.   Your office staff are always kind,, caring, and professional.  Thank you for keeping Toby and Iggy Rose healthy.   You ALL are the best!!

Dr. McCready was amazing and took time to educate my granddaughter on the proper care for her new pet. Warm, engaging and knowledgeable is what we wanted for our newest little family member and she delivered!
I’ve been going here for some time with my cat and it’s been great. Everyone there is super chill and helpful. The only downside is when it closes honestly.

This is for Dr. Pollard! We haven't seen her in years as we moved, but I wanted to take a minute to thank her for the YEARS of Thorough care she took with our many animals. We had a hamster named Cujo and he was very special. He was sick and Dr. Pollard tried her best to save him, even keeping him overnight and checking on him. We had 6 dogs, 3 birds, a guinea pig & I couldn't count how many hamsters. They were all in to see the great Dr. Pollard. She was the absolute best with our pride & joy, A pitbull/lab/sharpei mix (Spencer) throughout the 2000's.
We very much miss her!
Highly Recommended

All of the staff were very friendly and attentive.  Dr. Pollard was wonderful and gentle with my senior chihuahua! He's always very nervous at the vet, but she was able to help him relax. We'll definitely be returning!
Completely satisfied with all services & personnel.
This facility is awesome.  You don't have to wait a month or so to get an appointment.   The rates are so reasonable & the staff are courteous and willing to accommodate.   I highly recommend.

We love this place! Everyone is friendly and helpful. I would absolutely recommend this vet to anyone.
*UPDATE* We are still completely impressed by this vet's office and so happy we found this place.

We thought that the staff was great but we when it came to the doctor it was a little different we got the feeling that she was not happy with the breed of puppy that we had and it was are first time in I guess I was expecting something else but I am going to try again and go with a different doctor and see how it goes he has to come back for his next shots

In my humble opinion & experience, the best veterinary clinic, doctors & techs in Phoenix. They are kind, & compassionate people who enjoy working with animals.
I recommend without hesitation.

First visit and everyone was nice and professional.
clean and welcoming. Only suggestion is could use different chairs(not very sturdy uncomfortable kind of shaky). Dr. Pollard was nice and explained things to me. So far so good.update: back again as an emergency and they got us in fast. Really appreciate they're kindness and professional touch. Thank you Dr Pollard.

When we first walked in front desk was very friendly asking us if this is Mia. Staff were so friendly wanting to see our little one. Dr Sander is fantastic with her care and answering all our questions.
Everyone is welcoming.  My dog Jimi is not great around other pets, so they are conscious of this and make sure that we come and out with no issues.
We love Dr Pollard!  She’s always so thorough with my Millie. Even printed us out a couple for her new prescription 💗 …
Took my chinchilla there and ended up having a tooth issue he's better now and taking two meds
Staff was great, Dr was very informative 👍 …

This place is great !!! I read all the glowing reviews, didn't think any place could have a satisfaction index
this high. Went anyway.. Our 1 year old Chi was instantly at home & relaxed (unheard of for him)
He was also at home with the vet, Dr, McCready. (again, unheard of)
Dr, McCready was fantastic, very professional, very knowledgeable (yes I kept peppering her with questions)
she did not mind a bit. In addition to Dr, McCready, the Vet Tech, & front office staff were great.
The place is neat, clean & does not smell.
Yes, Dr, McCready is our vet from now on, they genuinely care...
Edit to add on 4-19-23
Since that first review, we have on addition o Dr, McCready, seen Dr, ,Flick & Dr, Pollard. We think more of these folks now than we did back then. We have also added A Green Cheek Conure parrot to our family & Dr, McCready is great with him. Avian vet & reg vet all in one!!?

We have been taking our "kids" to Camelwest for years and have never had a bad experience.
The doctors and staff truly care about our pets and provide information we need to help us make the best decisions for their treatment.
AMAZING, PROFESSIONAL, CARING, & HELPFUL STAFF! OFFICE ALWAYS IS CLEAN AND SMELLS SANITIZED..🥰😍👍
Great place. Lucy got her nails done. No easy task. They did a great job. Thank you 👍.
Best customer service from front office staff, awesome Providers. They always take care of our furbabies. Great paw plans. Come for your family/pets.

I was worried about how my bunny would react when being checked. The veterinarian was so gentle and he was not stressed at all. Their prices are very reasonable. I recommend this place to anyone looking for high quality pet care.

Dr McCready was just absolutely amazing with my dog who can be a bit unsure of strangers. She was patient and understanding which I greatly appreciate. This was my first appointment at the clinic and I will continue to bring my dog here. Definitely recommend for those who are looking for a clinic in the area! The techs were also very professional and kind. Great staff overall.

This is the only place I trust with my rabbits. Dr. McCready is knowledgeable about their specific care and always leaves me feeling at ease when answering my questions. I would recommend Camelwest to all rabbit owners in the area!
I have been going to Camel West for decades. I only trust Camel West for all my pets health. I currently have two cats and one dog. (One cat is camera shy)

My senior fur baby was seen by Dr Finch she was very gentle with Sadie Lynn and I am happy that she took her time and was very thorough with Sadie's senior check up.
The girls up front are always pleasant.
Very nice people and very clean I love it and they are so caring about the animals Thank you so much
Everyone is super nice here great customer service and communication!
Always helpful and friendly. Been coming here for the past 15 years.
Excellent experience!  Dr Flick is the best!  The staff is great!  Thank you for all the great care.
Caring and compassionate vets. They always take such great care of my pets.

We cannot thank the team at CamelWest enough for their incredible care of our dog, Bella. When she had a recent health scare, their quick assessment and honest advice to seek emergency care at AVECCC likely saved her life. Since that emergency, CamelWest has been handling her follow-up care with so much compassion and expertise. It’s a huge relief knowing she is in such capable hands. Highly recommend them for anyone looking for a vet that truly puts the animal first. A special shout out to Dr McCready, your compassion and expertise have been so comforting.
The animals are treated with respect.

Dr. McCready has been my vet for the past 9 years. She has gone above and beyond with my dog that has a very rare fast growing aggresive skin cancer .  I feel without Dr. McCreadys expertise and knowledge I would have lost my dog to cancer . Thank you so much Camelwest Animal Hospital .

I went to this place because my main vet was too far booked out. So I took my dog in for teeth cleaning and something to help with my dogs tooth pain temporarily until I took her to my main veterinarian.

Instead they took 3 minutes to look at my dog and I was quoted $2,400 and was SHOCKED! Then they shown a pamphlet with a ridiculous membership subscription service! Now Vets are doing subscriptions now? Unreal! My dog is over 16yrs old. I don’t need a subscription service to pay monthly to “save money” over the years. Do you people even listen to your customers? Why would you even offer a vet subscription service for a dog this old!

This place is highway robbery! And they expected a $95 vet visit after only being in the room for a few minutes just for me to decline these insane scamming prices? Outrageous. This place only cares about money. Never been to a vet that was this expensive, ever! Ended up going to the vet on McDowell and they did it for $400! Saved myself $2,000 walking out of this place and going somewhere else.
They are so helpful and I appreciate Dr sheek she helps my cat Wednesday. She is so sweet to her.

I went in for my cat’s ear infection but also learned of potential Resorptive Lesions. I would’ve never thought this could happen to my poor kitty, and had they not checked, I’m afraid my ignorance would’ve costed additional pain and uncomfort. We are working to get her taken care of in the coming weeks. I have been to several vets and I’ve never had them explain to me the situation/diagnosis as well as this place. I think tenderness and transparency are extremely important, and Camelwest did just that. Looking forward to getting my baby back to peak health and I can’t thank this vet enough.
Excellent as usual. Timely, caring and explanation of what is going on and what to expect . Would recommend to anyone !
The staff and doctors are so caring and friendly. They have cared for many of our pets and always have a high standard of care.
Great Staff!  Pets receive excellent attention and care.  It’s easy to tell that the doctors and staff care about the animals and owners

I had such a great experience! Everyone was extremely friendly from the moment we walked in, and I never once felt rushed. They took the time to explain everything clearly, and all the information I received was very helpful and reassuring.

My dog is usually shy and nervous at appointments, but the staff was so patient and gentle with her. They didn’t give up and made sure both of us felt comfortable the entire time. It truly felt like they genuinely care about their patients and pet parents.

I will definitely be coming back, and I really appreciate everyone’s patience and kindness. Thank you for making what could have been a stressful visit such a positive experience! 🐾
Dr McCready is fantastic!  She gives you great advice and options and truly has your family pet’s best health at heart!💜 🐾 …
Dr. McReady made my scared cat feel comfortable and did an excellent job of explaining treatment. She is kind, professional, and skilled.
Been going there for 2+ years. Very pleased with the service provided. I definitely recommend them.
Staff and dr.’s are very attentive and professional.

The care they have continued to give to our fur baby is beyond words can describe I am so blessed for our neighbors referring us and thankful
For the staff and veterinaries who truly care for the pets thank you!
Awesome place, it was very clean and the people were nice. Really like the phone check up on how my baby is doing.
Excellent service! Amazing reception staff, technicians, and Veterinarians.  Always a pleasant experience.  Highly recommend.

Update 2025: Switched our creatures here after a dramatic falling out with Agua Fria Animal Hospital and it’s been such a great experience. We’ve been coming here for over a year now. As said before, everyone truly cares and I love that they don’t pressure you into unnecessary services. Dr. Sheek and Dr. Flick really know their stuff and have been lovely to work with. We found out one of our Danes has valley fever and due to the early screening, we’ve been told the condition is manageable. I’m really glad we found a vet who puts our doggos first.

My first experience at Camelwest was excellent. My hamster came up with a swollen eye and they were able to work me in quickly (even as a new client!). The staff is lovely. The technician was so gentle with my hammy. Dr. McCready was so kind and attentive and answered all my questions. Highly recommend!
Our visit was very good. Everyone was very nice and knowable and kind. I would encourage anyone that needs treatment for their pet should call for an appointment.

Staff was professional and friendly. Thet took are information and we waited a few minutes and were placed in a roon. The Vet tec was friendly and very professional. She asked specific questions, and prepaired us to see the zvet. The Vet came in and asked us several questions and examined our turtle. We were very pleased with the service we received.
I moved all over the country with different vets and this is by far our favorite!! Great place and great people.
Fantastic staff!
They are kind, compassionate, Very knowledgeable and professional.

They screwed over a 20+ year customer, just to drive a stupid office visit.  A customer, that hadn't missed an annual exam ... Ever.  Not focused on cost effective care solutions.  Be careful, I encourage you to question everything.  Good luck

The team shows genuine concern & care for our dogs. They understand that animals, like humans are nervous about seeing a doctor, and each animal has their own personality.
They comfort and care for each animal like it is their own pet.

When we arrived the Receptionist was a bit snippy. Vet Tech was fabulous!  Dr. Jennifer was great.  My dog got a thorough exam.  They did a great job of cleaning up her wounds and draining the infection.  Overall a good experience.  We will visit again.
Always a pleasant professional experience
Always thorough. The veterinary doctors are excellent. We've been going to them for 8 years.
Prompt friendly service
Took my dog in for injuries from a coyote attack. Everyone there was so kind and helpful!

this review is not for the store overall but primarily for the doctor. doctor pollard, although very kind she didn’t not provide proper information on what was being done to my cat. i was told “we are giving her fluids and meds” mind you i have never had an animal receive fluids so from the VERY uninformative and minimal information proved i was under the impression that the fluids would go in her arm, a technician came back in afterwards and said “oh she has a little water on her back let me get that.” it indeed was NOT water. it was her fluids spilling from the back of her neck. i wish that i would’ve been given more information on what would be done, where it was going, and what it would look like. this doctor and the technician that brought my car in needs to learn how to properly communicate what is being done and what to look out for so we aren’t left worried and confused.
Great service as always.
I love the staff at this veterinary, especially Dr. McCready. She explains everything very well and thoroughly. I trust her with my senior dogs healthcare.

Ive been coming here for over 10 years. The staff is always lovely and caring. I come here to get my rabbits nails trimmed and come here for wellness exams for my rabbits as well. The doctor is always gentle with my rabbits and shows that she cares, which makes me really happy to see. Even in emergency situations they have been the best. I will be coming back every time as long as the staff remains friendly, patient, caring and gentle with my pets as they always do.
Excellent vet. I'm so glad I found this place.

I moved to Arizona on April 2021 last year and needed a good vet practice for my two senior pups. I found Camelwest Animal Hospital had very nice reviews and gave it a try. I'm very happy with the quality of the service. The front desk ladies are awesome always being very sweet, patient and very professional. Doctors and Vet Techs are knowledgeable and kind. We've been seeing Dr. Pollard and I'm deeply grateful for her humanity during all the process of my pup with cancer. She made concrete actions that made me feel there was always her support with us. Simply invaluable.
I would definitely recommend them. Also, recommend that you have a look at their multiple wellness programs where you can cover multiple services for a  decent monthly fee. Since usually these types of services are average expensive for everyone, this is actually a great idea to work towards prevention, your healthy pet and your peace of mind. And no, this is not an ad. It's just that it's relieving to have a place where you know that you can trust your babies to the team.
Professional staff.  Highly recommend!!!

Had a fine visit, my cat was treated well .
Doctor was.friendly and answered all my questions.
Everyone was so helpful
Dr McCreedy was so good to take the time for a walk in, identified our pups issue was and made great suggestions to how we proceed with treatment

I was afraid I was going to lose my kitty but the doctor did a bood test and eased my fears. I've had my sweet boy for 17+ years...so the news was such a relief. I had called my previous vet, West Olive Animal Hospital, three times on Oct. 8th and they never returned my calls. I called that same day and Camelwest worked me in the next day. And, a thank you goes to my niece, Bree, for recommending them. The picture is of me and my baby boy.
We had a great expierence at Camelwest Animal Hospital

I have a small dog and he is getting very old.  We have been going to Dr. McCready for several years and she is just so knowledgeable, friendly and efficient, I have never been disappointed.  She doesn't push any services on you, she just explains for example, the insurance, certain medicines she thinks  your dog might need, etc. I genuinely recommend her!

All the Dr's at Camelwest are terrific.  Dr McCready is exceptional! She took great care of my Ginger.  I got more than 17 healthy years to spend with her and I know its because of Dr McCready.  She treated her like she was her own. My sister and many friends go to Camelwest and I only hear great things. They are happy with the care their furbabies get. I recommend them highly.  They offer monthly paw plans which is a great and affordable deal.  Choose from plans that fit your furbabies needs. Dr McCready is my main Dr but over the years, I have seen all the Dr's. I can say they all care, do their do diligence and have sympathy. Everyone including techs and front desk really listen to you and show compassion. I wish I could give more that 5 🌟 stars.
Very friendly, professional, and great with the animals.
Dr Pollard and front staff are amazing!!! 😻 My red eared slider, Skynyrd, may not love them- but I do!!!!! Thank you for saving my aquatic baby girl.
I had a great experience, every-time me and my pup go,  the facility is clean and organized and all the staff I’ve interacted with are kind, intelligent and well spoken.

Very compassionate group, gave us all the yime we needed to say goodbye to our family cat.
Great place!  I have been going there for 13 years now with my 2 dogs. Everyone there is very knowledgeable and caring.

Absolutely wonderful! From the phone call, the front dest, to the doctor and surroundings. And after calling around, very reasonable pricing. I highly recommend!
This is our 3rd pet we've had with them.

my demon cat was attended to really quick and given a list of vaccines she will be needing. knowledgeable and quick will be coming back for those vaccines.

Thank you for seeing my dog 🐕 and making him feel better. …

Overall a good place to bring your animals for care.
Convenient to my home. Friendly staff

All of the staff members are so caring, and all of the doctors listen and address my concerns and give great advice on how to better care for my fur babies 😃
We always feel safe and at peace during our visits!! …

I take all of my parrots to Avian vet Dr. McCready she's amazing and just the best, and so kind ,and good with all of my birds. ❤️😊 Thank you! …

Dr. McCready and Edwin at the front desk + everyone else that works here are absolutely phenomenal. Cannot recommend camelwest enough. They have been with us through some very severe and emotional situations such as saying goodbye to our girl as well as taken exceptional care of our other dog. Dr McCready understands my wife and I's ability to freak out about the smallest things after what happened with our girl, but she empathizes with us and is as thorough and realistic as can be. If you are looking for a vet that will provide the top notch care your pet deserves, Dr McCready is the vet for you. Thank you Dr McCready and camelwest.
Everyone was so kind, the tech and Dr. Listened and gave several options for the best health for my dog. Even clients in the waiting room were friendly and celebrated my dog's weight loss!

We can’t say enough great things about Dr. McCready and the entire team at Camelwest! The knowledge, compassion, and tenderness that Dr. McCready consistently provides is something we truly appreciate with every visit.

With four dogs, we’ve experienced our fair share of ups and downs, and the entire team has always gone above and beyond to accommodate emergencies, prescriptions, appointments, and preventative care. Thanks to their dedication, our fur kids receive the best possible treatment, and we are so grateful for their ongoing support.

To anyone searching for a veterinary hospital—look no further! This team is exceptional, and we couldn’t do it without them.

Much love and appreciation,
The Arredondo-Morales Family
The visit was good
Compassionate, knowledge and trustworthy... they care about my pets as well as me...!
They always do a great job of taking care of my 3 dogs who each have their own personalities & needs. Front desk gals great and all of the Dr. 's are good!
Everyone was super nice and very thorough! Thank you!

I've been coming to this clinic for a few years now. I use to be a VA, and have worked with two other clinics previously, and can say from what I've seen and experienced, these people are passionate about their work. Every time they are always so kind and sweet to my babies, and this showed doubly on Valentine's Day this year. We had to put down our sweet girl Moxxi, who had been battling with a severe case of HCM for 2 years (it came out of nowhere). We knew she was struggling and made the tough call to put her down. Dr. McCready had been working with me in her care, and considering how tough it is to put a beloved pet down, she made the process so much easier. The level of care and compassion was outstanding. She knew Moxxi got anxious and we wanted her to be as calm as possible to make this as easy for her as we could. Dr. McCready went out to our car to give Moxxi an injection to calm her down and was willing to wait for her to be completely relaxed in the process. She walked everyone through (my husband, mother and myself) through all the steps that will be taking place. She made sure Moxxi had absolutely zero distress and even told us how good she was when they were giving her her IV catheter. She walked us through the injections, gave us plenty of time to say our goodbyes, was so empathetic the entire time and even helped us get ink spots of her nose and paws as well as fur clippings. She even worked with us regarding her remains. They work with AquaCrossings, which I can't speak highly enough of them either. We were able to get her remains back yesterday, including her preserved skull, which was beautifully done. I've seen quite a few euthanasias before, even aided in several, but this is up there on the list of smoothest and best passings I've witnessed. Death is never easy for anyone, but Dr. McCready made sure that Moxxi passed with as much ease and grace as anyone could ever hope for. She went without distress, everyone was able to be there and she told us step by step what would happen. I couldn't have asked for a better passing for our baby girl. Thank you so much Dr. McCready for all your help, your empathy, and your care.

She also sees our rabbit Reggie(Sire Reginald Fluffybottom). He has to get dentals done every few months, and he isn't a fan to say the least.
